raw.event_description:
Created by students from local schools, the works in this exhibition speak to the seasonal changes from autumn to winter, like snowfalls and long periods of darkness, and the cultural traditions they help shape.

Celebrate the exhibition during the Community Open House with friends, family and neighbours. Enjoy live entertainment, activities, crafts and cultural displays. Vote for your favourite artwork in the 'Tis the Season People's Choice Awards.

name.sv: Rhapsody in Blue & Dvořák – Orgeln som orkester
name.en: Rhapsody in Blue & Dvořák – The Organ as Orchestra

description.fi:
George Gershwinin Rhapsody in Blue ja Antonín Dvořákin Sellokonsertto esitetään ainutlaatuisina versioina, joissa Musiikkitalon urut säestävät nämä legendaariset konsertot yhden miehen voimin.

Tämä uniikki toteutus yhdistää kaksi huippusolistia ja urkujen valtavan sointimaailman tavalla, jota ei ole aiemmin Suomessa kuultu.

Solisteina maailmalla mainetta niittänyt pianisti Irina Zahharenkova ja Turun sellokilpailun 2026 voittaja sellisti Artturi Aalto. Urkurina Aleksanteri Wallius.

description.sv:
För första gången i Finland! George Gershwins Rhapsody in Blue och Antonín Dvořáks cellokonsert framförs i unika versioner där orgeln i Musikhuset ackompanjerar dessa legendariska verk – framförda av en enda musiker.

Denna unika produktion förenar två framstående solister och orgelns mäktiga klangvärld på ett sätt som aldrig tidigare hörts i Finland.

Solister är den internationellt hyllade pianisten Irina Zahharenkova och cellisten Artturi Aalto, vinnare av Åbo cellotävling 2026. Organist är Aleksanteri Wallius.

– Eaux natales
– Vers l’espérance

Aleksanteri Wallius, orgel

– Rhapsody in Blue

Aleksanteri Wallius, orgel

— Paus —

– Cellokonsert i h-moll

Artturi Aalto, cello
Aleksanteri Wallius, orgel

description.en:
For the first time in Finland! George Gershwin’s Rhapsody in Blue and Antonín Dvořák’s Cello Concerto are presented with the grand organ of Musiikkitalo.

George Gershwin’s Rhapsody in Blue and Antonín Dvořák’s Cello Concerto are presented in unique versions, where the grand organ of the Musiikkitalo accompanies these legendary concert works – performed by a single musician.

This exceptional concept brings together two outstanding soloists and the vast sonic palette of the organ in a way never before heard in Finland.

The soloists are internationally acclaimed pianist Irina Zahharenkova and cellist Artturi Aalto, winner of the Turku Cello Competition 2026. The organist is Aleksanteri Wallius.



Programme

Thierry Escaich (b. 1965): Poèmes
– Eaux natales
– Vers l’espérance

Aleksanteri Wallius, organ

George Gershwin (1898–1937):
– Rhapsody in Blue

Irina Zahharenkova, piano
Aleksanteri Wallius, organ

— Intermission —

Antonín Dvořák (1841–1904):
– Cello Concerto in B minor

Artturi Aalto, cello
Aleksanteri Wallius, organ

 

Musiikkitalo

27.10.2026

19.00-20.50

Tickets 24-54€
